statements.impact_statement: Affected versions are <2.3.2. DevSuperSuite runtime enforces Flask 3.0.3 with strict session cookie domain isolation.
statements.action_statement: Continuous dependency audit gate in CI validates Flask >= 3.0.0.

statements.impact_statement: Bleichenbacher timing attack against RSA PKCS#1 v1.5. DevSuperSuite cryptographic policy mandates Ed25519 and ECDSA P-384 exclusively.
statements.action_statement: RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 is disabled at runtime AST level and rejected in HSM enclave attestation.

statements.impact_statement: Unintended leak of Proxy-Authorization header during cross-origin redirect. DevSuperSuite internal mTLS proxies do not use Basic Proxy-Authorization.
statements.action_statement: SPIFFE/SPIRE dynamic SVID workload identities govern all egress communication.
